title: endpoint-receipt/0.1 — PROPOSAL — NOT ADOPTED
description: Sibling schema proposal for contract §7 D-5 (Nono↔Popeye Session Credential Contract v0.1, canonical at fiskroad/contracts/NONO_POPEYE_SESSION_CREDENTIAL_CONTRACT_v0.1.md). PROPOSAL ONLY, NOT DECIDED, NOT ADOPTED: no code in this repository (nono) loads, validates against, or otherwise references this file. D-5 remains an open joint-review decision between the nono maintainers, the popeye maintainers, and the program lead.

session_id.description: Opaque per-session identifier, minted by nono at governed launch and echoed by popeye's issuance response (contract §2.1 request field, §2.3 response field, §5 join key). Never path-derived.

key_refs.description: The non-secret key_ref chain for this session (contract §2.3, §4.2, §5): one entry per issued key under this session_id, including any in-session renewals ('new key, same session, new key_ref' per §4.2). Never contains the bearer secret itself — only the loggable key_ref identifier.

session_window.description: The session's time window, used by contract §5's join semantics: receipt.session window [start, end] must be a superset of the ledger row timestamps for the keys in key_refs.

start.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of session start (governed launch), satisfying contract §5's join requirement.

end.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of session end, or null for a still-in-progress session (contract §4.2: 'session end... SHOULD trigger best-effort key revocation... the receipt records session end regardless').

layer_attestations_ref.description: A reference/correlation key pointing at the existing layer-attestation census (crates/nono/src/receipt.rs's EnforcementReceipt.layers), never the inlined attestation rows themselves — mirrors the 'never duplicate a fact that already has a canonical home' reasoning EnforcementReceipt's SessionOutcome doc comment already states for why refusal detail is not duplicated into a second field.
